## Episode Thesis

This is a personal-finance and FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) episode of Rika Tillsammans. Guest Johan Strand explains how he retired at 55, mainly through maximum salary sacrifice into his occupational pension (tjänstepension), trading salary for extra holiday, frugal living and a smaller FIRE portfolio. The talk also covers his computer-store business going bankrupt in 2008, why he calls mortgage pre-approvals a trap, whether your home is an investment, and FIRE's philosophical roots. There is no equity analysis and no buy/sell views on stocks. Most company names come from ads or passing examples.
